template.name: Payroll & HR
template.description: Employee onboarding and termination, employee master data, time and attendance, payroll calculation, GOSI and end-of-service benefits, payroll disbursement through WPS and payroll accounting.

risks.title: Ghost employees exist on the payroll, or terminated employees continue to be paid.
Unauthorized changes are made to salary, allowances, bank details or grade in the employee master.
Payroll is calculated incorrectly (overtime, allowances, deductions, GOSI contributions, unpaid leave) due to erroneous inputs or system configuration.
Payroll costs are incomplete or recorded in the wrong period (accrued bonuses, leave, end-of-service benefits).
Salary payments are made to the wrong bank accounts or the payment file is altered after approval.
End-of-service benefit (EOSB) and leave liabilities are not measured in accordance with IAS 19 and the Saudi Labour Law.
Payroll expense is misclassified across cost centres, capital projects or functional lines.

controls.title: New hire and termination authorization
controls.description: New employees are added to the HR system only upon an approved requisition, signed employment contract and completed onboarding checklist (Iqama/national ID, GOSI registration, bank details) verified by HR. Terminations are processed within two working days of the approved exit form, with final settlement calculated and approved by the HR Manager and Finance before the last payroll.

controls.title: Employee master data change approval and review
controls.description: Changes to sensitive employee master fields (salary, allowances, grade, bank account, cost centre) require an approved change form and are entered by HR and approved in the HR system by the HR Manager. Payroll runs a monthly master data change report, which is compared to approved change forms by the Payroll Supervisor and reviewed by the Finance Manager.

controls.title: Time, attendance and overtime approval
controls.description: Attendance is captured from the biometric/time system and interfaced to the payroll system; overtime, unpaid leave and shift allowances require line manager approval in the system before the payroll cut-off. The Payroll Supervisor reviews an exceptions report of overtime above 60 hours per month.

controls.title: Payroll register review and month-on-month reconciliation
controls.description: Before payment, the Payroll Supervisor prepares a reconciliation of the current payroll register to the prior month, explaining movements by joiners, leavers, salary changes and variable pay, and validates the headcount to the approved HR headcount report. The Finance Manager reviews the reconciliation and a sample of individual variances above 10% before approving the payroll.

controls.title: Payroll system configuration and statutory tables
controls.description: Payroll calculation rules (GOSI rates and ceilings, overtime formulas, EOSB accrual rules, allowance policies) are configured in the payroll system by a restricted role; changes are tested and approved by the Payroll Manager and Finance before migration. Statutory rates are validated annually against GOSI and Labour Law updates.

controls.title: Payroll payment file approval and WPS release
controls.description: The bank payment file (WPS/SARIE format) is generated from the approved payroll register; the file total and record count are agreed to the register by Treasury before upload, and the payment is released in the bank portal under dual authorization by two signatories independent of HR and Payroll. The bank portal restricts editing of uploaded files.

controls.title: Payroll to GL reconciliation and cost allocation
controls.description: The Payroll Accountant reconciles the payroll register (gross pay, deductions, employer contributions, net pay) to the GL payroll postings and the bank debit monthly, and reviews the allocation of payroll cost to cost centres and capital projects against HR cost-centre assignments. The reconciliation is reviewed by the Financial Controller.

controls.title: Payroll accruals (bonus, leave, unpaid salary)
controls.description: At period end, Finance accrues bonuses per approved schemes, unused annual leave from the HR leave balance report, and any salary for days worked but not yet paid; the accrual schedule is reviewed and approved by the Financial Controller.

controls.title: End-of-service benefit valuation review
controls.description: The EOSB obligation is calculated annually by an independent actuary under IAS 19 (projected unit credit method) using census data extracted from the HR system and validated by HR and Finance for completeness and accuracy; monthly accruals are based on the actuarial roll-forward. The Financial Controller reviews the actuarial assumptions (discount rate, salary growth, attrition) and reconciles the valuation to the ledger.

controls.title: Periodic headcount verification
controls.description: HR performs a semi-annual physical verification (or line manager attestation) of all employees on the payroll against the HR system and the payroll register, including verification of identification documents, and investigates any employee not confirmed.

controls.title: Segregation of duties between HR, Payroll and Treasury
controls.description: System roles ensure that HR maintains employee master data, Payroll processes the payroll run, and Treasury releases payments, with no single user holding more than one of these capabilities. Access is reviewed quarterly by the HR Director and Finance Manager.
